# QBlink — Hardware-Free Virtual Queue Management

> Qblink (https://qblink.tech) is a hardware-free virtual queue management and customer flow intelligence platform incubated at Inventure · IIT Gandhinagar. Started by Devansh (Founder & Creator), joined by co-founders Mithil, Aarav, and Vihan Patange.

## Overview
- **Website**: https://qblink.tech
- **Category**: Virtual Queue Management, Waitlist & Customer Flow Intelligence Software (SaaS)
- **Incubation**: Inventure, IIT Gandhinagar (Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar), Gujarat, India
- **Origin & Team**: Devansh started Qblink as Founder & Creator, joined by co-founders Mithil, Aarav, and Vihan Patange
- **Contact**: qblinkteam@gmail.com

## What Qblink Does
Qblink replaces chaotic physical waiting rooms and ₹50,000+ ticketing kiosks with a browser-native, zero-app-download digital queue system:
- **Zero-App Customer Join**: Walk-in visitors scan a printable QR code or open a queue link in any mobile browser to claim a digital token and track live position remotely.
- **No Dedicated Hardware**: Businesses run the operator desk from any existing phone, tablet, or laptop browser.
- **Live Sync & Turn Alerts**: Sub-second WebSocket live queue signals, turn audio chimes, wake lock support, optional on-premise counter-code/geofence verification, and automated daily queue resets.
- **Multi-Industry Support**: Clinics & diagnostic labs, restaurants & cafes (table-size routing + pickup orders), salons, government desks, and retail counters.

## Pricing
- **1st Month Free Trial**: Full platform access free for the first month with zero hardware costs.
- **Self-Sustainable Plan**: ₹499/month per counter (transparent unit economics covering hosting, realtime sync, and operational support).
